visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian woman with long black hair sits in an indoor room, smiling warmly while holding a black and white cat. The setting is softly lit, with a neutral wall and a mirror visible in the background. (2) The woman appears tired, yawning with her hand over her mouth. She is wearing a light pink sleeveless top. Yellow graphic text 'GRWM' is overlaid on the frame. (3) She begins her makeup routine by applying concealer under her eyes and using a brush to blend powder on her face. Her expressions are focused as she looks into a small handheld Chanel mirror. (4) Close-up shots show her brushing her eyebrows with a spoolie. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features. She handles various high-end cosmetic containers. (5) She presents a red cream blush in a black Chanel container and dabs it onto her cheeks with her finger, blending it out while smiling at the camera. (6) A transition reveals a black Chanel gift box containing a new eyeshadow palette. She opens it to show the mirror and the four shimmering eyeshadow shades inside. (7) Multiple close-up shots feature various eyeshadow palettes with different color stories, such as deep purples, golds, and reds. Her hands carefully move the palettes to catch the light. (8) She swatches a gold eyeshadow on her arm and then applies it to her eyelids using a small brush, looking into the palette's mirror for precision. (9) She finishes the look with mascara and lipstick. She poses with her hands near her face, tilting her head to show the completed makeup. Yellow text 'Done!' appears. (10) The video ends with her holding the eyeshadow palette up to the camera one last time while talking. She wears silver Chanel earrings that complement the luxury theme.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor home environment with neutral-colored walls, a staircase, a mirror, and soft indoor lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking Mandarin in a gentle, warm tone, accompanied by soft indoor room tone and minor rustling sounds. (2) An upbeat electronic pop track with female English vocals begins as the woman lets out a soft yawn. The music serves as a steady rhythmic bed. (3) As the narration continues, the woman's voice becomes more professional and informative. The sounds of makeup compacts clicking and brushes moving are occasionally audible over the music. (4) The female narrator describes the makeup application process with clear articulation. The music's volume is balanced well under the speech, maintaining a positive and energetic mood. (5) During the unboxing sequence, a subtle 'whoosh' or 'ding' sound effect marks the transition. The physical handling of plastic packaging and palette covers creates small, percussive noises. (6) The voice exhibits higher arousal and a positive valence while showing the eyeshadow colors. The music's synthesizer texture remains bright. (7) The video concludes with the woman's parting words as the background music gradually fades out in a controlled manner.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Tutorial -> Product Review -> Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a beauty tutorial and product review, specifically showcasing the use of Chanel makeup products. The video blends personal vlog elements (the cat) with high-end cosmetic unboxing and application to engage followers interested in luxury beauty.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of the Chanel logo, unboxing of new Chanel collections, and detailed swatching and application of the products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished beauty vlog that effectively uses luxury brand association and relatable lifestyle hooks to maintain viewer interest.
